author_controls.scope: Unchanged original scripts, owned temporary markdown and mocked read failure; eight bounded child interpreters for hash seeds.

confirmed_findings: discover increments total file count before read and continues on error without increasing no_frontmatter; owned injected failure yields100percent frontmatter coverage despite zero successful reads.
discover immediately continues for missing frontmatter, excluding plain Markdown body links and headings from patterns. This is scope limitation, not content deletion.

generate_schema.build_field_fixes iterates popular values set and selects first similar; equal candidate input yields different mapping across Python hash seeds1..8. Artificial edit-distance fixture, not semantic synonym proof.
source_only_findings: Schema generator returns explicitly labelled draft; fuzzy alias matching threshold0.3 and fixed domain keywords are heuristics, not duplicate-content evidence.
Type/path hints also iterate sets; broader whole-schema determinism unqualified.
Discovery enum coverage uses occurrence count for list entries, so may exceed file percentage for multi-valued fields; not tested here.
